query: INSERT INTO schedule_definitions(schedule_id,change_id,instruction_id,enabled,definition_json,imported_continuity_json,created_at_ms,updated_at_ms,authority) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,'{"kind":"none"}',?,?,'central') ON CONFLICT(schedule_id) DO UPDATE SET change_id=excluded.change_id,instruction_id=excluded.instruction_id,enabled=excluded.enabled,definition_json=excluded.definition_json,updated_at_ms=excluded.updated_at_ms
